decisions.reason: Acceptance of the breakpoint guidelines changes responsive behavior, not the landing page's visual design attributes. The separate approval of the top half is already represented by its existing same-message Event.
The accepted breakpoint guidance does not change the currently established font or button-color design tokens.
Following existing breakpoint guidelines does not necessarily change the selected implementation stack or the stated handoff objective.
Breakpoint guidance does not change the shared header, footer, or dark-theme treatment. Those decisions arise from the separately accepted item 2 and are already represented by a same-message Event.
The accepted breakpoint guidance concerns general website responsive behavior and does not necessarily alter the console shell's styling targets or deliverable.
Breakpoint guidance does not change the footer's page coverage or visual theme. The footer decision comes from the separately accepted shared-page proposal and is already represented.
